                LAURA PRESSLEY’S REQUEST OR CORRECTION TO

1.     Dr. Laura Pressley, pro se Intervenor, files this request for the ALJ’s to correct SOAH

Order No. 30 Attachment B (59475-5835).

2.     On page 43 of 49 of Order 30, Attachment B, Intervenor 602, Laura Pressley’s link, the

following needs to be corrected:

                  a. Column “First Link” should be changed from M8 to F34, and
                  b. Column “All Links that Part is Affected by” should be changed from M8
                     to F34.
